title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Leaner File Watching on Large Projects
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.33.5 fixes the file watcher so it skips build and .gradle folders, the same exclusion already applied at startup.

highlights.title: Build Folder Watcher Exclusion
highlights.description: File change tracking no longer scans build and .gradle output folders, avoiding unnecessary work while you code on large projects.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Excluded build/ and .gradle/ folders from the file watcher, matching the exclusion already used during the initial project scan, so ongoing file tracking no longer wastes time on generated output.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No other functional changes to extension behavior in this release.
